notes.title: Steam Beta update 2
notes.notes:
Updates:

More room areas available, only 1 area is now fully locked away
Ambient Sound issues fixed

Known Issues:

There is a problem with weapon particle effects where they "follow" the guns, this will be solved shortly

notes.title: New game update, and a call to action!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31405127/dc3284f83655792d6a90ec12776f0fb14d4b34f4.png
Hello traveler! As you might have guessed, we have a new build up for you to play! With several improvements and new additions, including a height adjustment option! You can see the full changelist on the Steam Community Forum here: Game Updates.
 
We also have a few things we need your input on at the moment, so please take a minute to let us know what you think by commenting on this post. :)
 
The Shooting Range
We are thinking about making the shooting range longer and add some more variety to it. What are your thoughts on that?
 
Teleportation
Should we add a new "mini teleport" movement option, that steps you forward with each movement?
 
As always, we really appreciate your feedback, so don't be afraid  of letting us know what you think of the new update, and report any new issues you might encounter in our discussion forum here on Steam. 
 
Cheers,
Sanna, and the team at Windfall Studios.
